_nativeGames: Native games: open-source PC ports rebuilt from decompilation/recompilation projects. "id" is a Flathub id (source flathub) or "pkg" an Arch package (source archlingmo: shown as coming soon until a repository has it). needsOwnCopy: the game data must come from the user's own copy; never link to ROM sites.

_aliases: Flathub id -> Arch package, for apps whose AppStream ids differ between Flathub and Arch
_antiCheatWatch: Popular online games checked against Are We Anti-Cheat Yet on the games page; only those still Denied or Broken are shown. Names as written there (accents, case and symbols are ignored).
_curated: Curated apps whose repository has no AppStream data (mirrors of the developers' own packages, see packaging/thirdparty/craft-apps). Shown when pacman's sync db has "pkg". repo: the ArchLingmo repository that carries it when it isn't [archlingmo] ("archlingmo-craft": GitHub release assets, scripts/publish-craft.sh); while pacman.conf doesn't list it the app is still shown, with "Enable and Install" (consent, then lingmo-store-helper enable-repo). Media only from the official repos, pinned to the release tag. experimental: badge and warning banner. opens: file types, shown as information (never made default handlers).

summary.en: Write and design documents; opens and saves Word files
summary.pt_BR: Escreva e formate documentos; abre e salva arquivos do Word

description.en:
WordCraft is a fast, open-source word processor with a familiar ribbon: styles, tables, track changes, references and mail merge.

A free alternative to Microsoft Word.

Experimental (pre-alpha). Work on copies of your files.
description.pt_BR:
O WordCraft é um editor de texto livre e rápido, com a faixa de opções que você já conhece: estilos, tabelas, controle de alterações, referências e mala direta.

Uma alternativa livre ao Microsoft Word.

Experimental (pré-alfa). Trabalhe com cópias dos seus arquivos.
